key_insight: The paper introduces a parallel monolithic FSI solver for zero-mass-ratio vortex-induced vibrations, coupling fluid, structure, and mesh motion in one implicit ALE formulation.
engineering_relevance: It enables scalable simulation of massless cylinder vibration problems in 2D and 3D, which is important for predicting VIV behavior in lightweight flexible structures.
method: Finite element monolithic FSI solver in an ALE framework with implicit time stepping
Variable-Lamé pseudo-solid mesh deformation model for moving mesh handling
Lagrange-multiplier no-slip coupling with distributed parallel enforcement strategies
evidence_signal: The solver was verified with manufactured solutions, showed second-order accuracy in time, matched prior 2D VIV results for Re 100–300, and captured nonperiodic 3D oscillations at Re = 300.
watch_item: Using a direct solver (MUMPS) may limit practical scalability and memory efficiency for larger 3D problems despite demonstrated runs up to 768 cores.
paper_title: A parallel solver for vortex-induced vibrations at zero mass ratio
